import type { CriticalAlertContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class CriticalAlert extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        urgency: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        message: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        details: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    urgency: CriticalAlertContract['urgency'];
    message: string;
    details: CriticalAlertContract['details'];
    constructor();
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
